description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Books the visit at a free time from check_availability. Only after the client confirmed the service, the time, the address and the price. The company messages the client (WhatsApp, or e-mail when given). Returns the request number and a token for get_request_status / cancel_request. Repeating the same call (same idempotency_key or the same data) returns the same booking — its token again only with the same idempotency_key, so send one to be able to retry.

address.description: Where the work is done: street, building, apartment, city.

answers.description: Answers to the service's questions: { question_id: option_id | [option_ids] | number | text }. Use the ids from list_services.

client_accepted_disclaimer.description: Needed with diagnosis: the client agreed it is a hint, not a diagnosis.

client_email.description: Optional: messages go to this e-mail instead of WhatsApp.

company.description: The company: the `company` of a find_companies result.

diagnosis.description: Optional: { brand, code } from diagnose — the technician sees it.

district.description: When company_info lists service_zones: the client's district as its zone id (e.g. "dubai:jlt"), or "other" when it is not in the list.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, 8–100 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -: the same key never books twice.

lang.description: Language for names and labels: ru, es, en, ar, pt, fr, de, it, tr, id, vi, th. Default en.

units.description: How many units (air conditioners…) — only for services that count units. Default 1.

name: book_appointment
title: Book the visit
